summary: After "Open the request" while signed out, only the typed code returned to that request; the emailed sign-in link always landed on the inbox.
fix: Asking for the email also sends the page to return to; the start route keeps it (when it is a safe admin page) in a 15-minute cookie for that browser, and the link's "Sign me in" returns there once. Opened in another browser, the link lands on the inbox as before.
